issues.where: the foreground rim and stepped walls across the chasm
issues.what: the rock reads as molded slabs, with angular cutouts, smooth bevels and thin bright cracks drawn over broadly uniform faces
issues.fix: Break up the slab silhouettes with irregular erosion and give the faces distinct grain, fracture relief and roughness.

issues.where: the cream mist bank across the upper right of the chasm
issues.what: a broad, smooth patch of mist lies across the rim with a nearly horizontal lower edge and little visible breakup around the ledges
issues.fix: Vary the fog density in depth and let the mist curl around and partially occlude successive ledges.

issues.where: the inner shelves and recesses in both crops
issues.what: the shelves disappear into near-black gaps with almost no reflected light, making separate layers read as cutouts
issues.fix: Add restrained sky and rock bounce to the upward-facing shelves while keeping the deepest crevices dark.

issues.where: the ledges in the upper-right and lower-left crops
issues.what: the texture smears over the rounded edges in broad stripes and the thin crack highlights are visibly stair-stepped
issues.fix: Use higher-resolution material detail at a consistent scale across tops and faces, and anti-alias the fine crack edges.

issues.where: the near cliff face in the left crop and the projecting shelf in the right crop
issues.what: the faces have stretched vertical streaks and abrupt polygonal breaks rather than chipped, layered stone
issues.fix: Replace the stretched mapping and add irregular fractures and small-scale relief to the exposed faces.

issues.where: the distant flats beneath the haze in the lower-left crop
issues.what: the surface collapses into long, parallel bands behind a straight transition, with little depth or local variation
issues.fix: Break up the parallel bands and vary the surface detail and haze gradually with distance.

issues.where: the red fronds in the two top crops
issues.what: the frond fringes break into harsh pale speckles and clipped-looking edges
issues.fix: Soften the alpha cutouts, improve fine-edge sampling and tie the highlights to the shape of the individual fibers.

issues.where: the near lip below the red trees and the slab at bottom center
issues.what: the edges repeat squared-off steps and the nearby stone detail stretches into parallel ribbons
issues.fix: Vary the edge geometry and keep the rock texture at a consistent scale across the lip and walls.

issues.where: the long-legged animal above the foliage at upper left
issues.what: the rodlike legs and smooth body read as a posed model, with no clear foot contact in the visible ground gaps
issues.fix: Vary the joint angles and leg loading, and add contact shadows and local ground coloration where the feet are visible.
